decentralization.label: Decentralization
decentralization.text: PhoLend DAO operates on the principles of decentralization, ensuring transparent and community-driven decision-making

Governance.label: Governance
Governance.text: PhoLend puts the power in the hands of the community. Token holders have the authority to propose and vote on protocol upgrades

lendingAndBorrowing.label: Lending and Borrowing
lendingAndBorrowing.text: Experience seamless lending and borrowing processes with smart contract technology, offering efficient and secure transactions
